targetTasks.summary: AlembicWorkspace controller executes P15 directly. Read parent AGENTS.md, active index/status, state root, Design §A/§12.2 P15/§12.3/§12.4, P2 freeze register, and accepted controller reviews for P9-P14. Produce evidence under the state root proving: (1) all P1-P14 task packages are accepted and P15 itself is executed; (2) frozen tokens from the P2 register remain present/stable, especially PlanStageId values coldStart/deepMining/moduleMining, job kind/source strings, response.tool names, lifecycle strings, coverage_ledger/deep_mining_rounds schema anchors, public routes, bootstrap-session prefix, Core export subpaths, source tags file-change/alembic-main-bootstrap/alembic-main-rescan, producerKind values, defer verdict, and Agent moduleMining/profile/partitioner keys; (3) CG-5 isolation/boundary gates remain green using repository-native lint/build checks; (4) BiliDili REAL-TEST evidence from P6/P9/P10/P11/P12/P13 covers required chains and G4 non-empty coverage, without rerunning unrelated real tests; (5) no package versions, release assets, provider config, thread ids, or public freeze values were modified. Run the smallest final validation set that covers this: task ledger projection, targeted frozen-token grep/import checks, Alembic/AlembicPlugin/AlembicCore/AlembicAgent build/boundary checks already rerun or freshly rerun as needed, and git diff/status checks. Record a TargetResultEnvelope for P15 and controller acceptance evidence if all gates pass. If any hard gate fails, record blocked with exact blocker and do not complete the demand.
